single.label: One Tulwar at home, one free pack slot
single.explanation: Original: step 4 takes the Tulwar off its home record, finds only one free pack slot and skips it, leaving the record at 0 Tulwars; step 7A then skips home slot 0 as empty and no step sets a goal. Corrected: the record is restored to 1, step 7A tries the Tulwar as a backup weapon and the Borg sets out to buy it from the home.
